# CANDIDATE: AFTERNOON_VWAP_MEAN_REVERSION

**Filed:** 2026-09-07
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In the early afternoon when intraday volatility wanes, price deviations from VWAP that lack volume expansion tend to revert to VWAP. This captures mean-reversion edge during low-volume, low-volatility periods.

## Mechanism

Between 12:00 and 13:30 EST, if the absolute price‑VWAP deviation exceeds 0.4 % AND the volume of the current bar is < 0.7 × the 20‑bar average volume, enter long when price < VWAP and short when price > VWAP at the bar’s close. Exit: stop at 1×ATR(5) from entry; primary target at VWAP; if price crosses VWAP with a close > VWAP + 0.2 % (long) or < VWAP – 0.2 % (short), allow a runner to trail 10 % off the highest‑water‑mark up to 1.5 R. Regime hints: VIX < 18 and day’s price within 0.2 % of open (no strong morning trend); avoid FOMC/major news.
